question:
Select the most appropriate homonym.

She went to the **court** to file a case.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Law place**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"court"** refers to a place where legal cases are heard and decided. (न्यायालय)

 
 
• **Example: **She went to the court to testify as a witness in the case.
 
 
 
• The correct homonym in this context is **"Law place"**, which represents a location used for legal proceedings. (न्याय स्थान)
 
 
• **Example: **The lawyer prepared her arguments to present them at the law place.
 
 
 
• Hence, the word "court" in this sentence matches the meaning of "law place."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Law place**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ground** (जमीन): A piece of land used for a specific purpose, like sports or construction.

 
 
• **Example:** The children were playing on the school ground.
 
 
 
• **Yard** (आंगन): An area of land adjoining a building, typically enclosed.
 
 
• **Example:** They planted flowers in their backyard.
 
 
 
• **Field** (मैदान): An open area of land used for farming or sports.
 
 
• **Example:** The farmers were working in the field all day.
